GG.Settings.CastFxSoundDurationMultiplie: Seal duration relative to cast sound

How long the on-screen sigil remains visible relative to the actual cast sound duration. For example, 0.50 = half the sound duration, 1.00 = the same duration, 1.25 = 25% longer, 1.50 = 50% longer. The sound itself is never shortened by this setting.
